scope: 32 previously opened baseline development trajectories only; no new policy, no new case, no SQLite
truth_access: No evaluation/source_estimates/scenario fields accessed; historical physical lower bounds reused only for reporting, never prefix decisions
exact_key: (channel,x,y) exact parsed binary64 coordinates; no coordinate quantization
ledger: movement charged as round(distance/5*1e6) us per action, measure 5s plus changed-channel 1s, successful clear 3+2s; clear does not retune radio
redundancy: Strict flags established before response from exact prior key, public source cap, cleared status, geometric silence or farther-than-old-negative certificate. Known/preclearcert/no polygon change alone are not strict redundancy.
frozen_trace_note: Diagnostic cost recomputation after deleting flagged measurements while freezing all other physical actions/coordinates; not execution of a modified policy and not its performance guarantee.

certificate_formula.condition: min_{v in vertices(C)} ((n-q)/norm(n-q)) dot (v-(n+q)/2) > 1e-5 m, with prior same live source no_signal at n
certificate_formula.proof: The affine minimum occurs at a vertex of the conservative convex region. For the actual source s in C, distance(s,q)>distance(s,n)>R, so q is certainly no_signal, even when distance(q,C)<=1500. No source coordinate or hidden R needed.
certificate_formula.scope: Known stationary omnidirectional channel; same source not yet cleared; never Q4. Exact same point handled by deterministic cache, separately.
certificate_formula.engineering_margin: 1e-5 metres of signed bisector distance; binary64 geometric certificate, not directed-rounding interval arithmetic.

next_hypotheses.mechanism: Before measuring a known uncleared channel, certify q is farther than a prior no_signal n throughout public outer region; append explicit derived no_signal but do not fabricate a client measurement/unknown coverage credit.
next_hypotheses.test: Separate switch from mid-scan cap; pair first against frozen baseline on development cases, then independent cases if successful. Verify all skipped outcomes causally, preserve current-channel accounting and geometry, report route divergences and total T/LB.

next_hypotheses.mechanism: Inside the scan loop, once public detected/cleared distinct set reaches16, skip remaining unknown channels only; retain known uncertified information measurements.
next_hypotheses.test: Separate switch and combined ablation; artificial event-order test for16th detection midway through scan; do not turn absence inference into observed coverage, do not skip known unresolved source.
